international.title: Top Democrats raise corruption concerns after Trump involvement in Jensen Huang’s Nvidia reinstatement – live
international.summary: Robert Garcia, top Democrat on House oversight, and Chris Van Hollen, vying for Senate leadership, join Republicans in expressing concern at return of CEO felled by affair scandal and Trump administration’s involvement Nvidia shares surge on Huang‘s return – business live Sign up to the Breaking News US email Nvidia ’s shares have surged by 31% at the start of trading following the news. The S+P 500 jumped 4.5% and is recovering nearly half of its brutal losses from last week, which was one of its worst since the 2008 financial crisis. Rallies for AI stocks had the Nasdaq composite up a market-leading 6.5%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1,117 points. Here’s Trump ’s full social media post, in which he also called Jensen Huang “a Great Patriot and National Treasure”. The NVIDIA Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO. The Country needs Jensen’s leadership at NVIDIA in order to ensure the Success and Prosperity of not only the Company, but the American Economy. The United States Government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security. The Attorney General of the United States has confirmed that the U.S. Government does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct. On a personal note, I have gotten to know Jensen, and he is a Great Patriot and National Treasure. Separately, NVIDIA should continue its thorough internal investigation of the Company’s compliance with U.S. export controls in order to ensure that it is fulfilling its legal obligations and Patriotic Duty to protect U.S. National Security. Congratulations to Jensen, the NVIDIA Board, to the People of the United States — and, indeed, the World! Continue reading...
